question: Simplify: (0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 8.34 × 0.15 + 5.95)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule to evaluate multiplication and division first.

First part: 0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 = 50.4 ÷ 14 = 3.6

Second part: 8.34 × 0.15 = 1.251

Substitute the parts back into the equation: 3.6 + 6.25 − 1.251 + 5.95

Add the positive terms together and subtract: 15.80 − 1.251 = 14.549

**∴ The correct answer is 14.549.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 8.34 × 0.15 + 5.95

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Brackets, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 8.34 × 0.15 + 5.95

⇒ (0.7 × 72) ÷ 14 + 6.25 − (8.34 × 0.15) + 5.95

⇒ 50.4 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 1.251 + 5.95

⇒ 3.6 + 6.25 − 1.251 + 5.95

Group all the positive values together first to make the addition easier:

⇒ (3.6 + 6.25 + 5.95) − 1.251

⇒ 15.80 − 1.251

⇒ 14.549

**∴ The correct answer is 14.549.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It specifies the sequence of mathematical operations: Brackets first, then Orders (powers/roots), followed by Division and Multiplication (left to right), and finally Addition and Subtraction (left to right).

Decimal Addition and Subtraction

When adding or subtracting decimal numbers, always align the decimal points precisely before proceeding with the calculation to prevent place-value errors.

Decimal Multiplication

Multiply the numbers as whole integers, then place the decimal point in the resulting product so that it has the exact total number of decimal places present in both of the original factors.
